vectors.name: set_ip_and_mask
vectors.description: Command 0x86: enable programming + program IP + program subnet mask
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtIpProg packet definition p.34-35

vectors.name: enable_dhcp
vectors.description: Command 0xC0: enable programming + enable DHCP (lower bits ignored)
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtIpProg packet definition p.34-35

vectors.name: enquiry
vectors.description: Command 0x00: enquiry only, node answers with ArtIpProgReply
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtIpProg packet definition p.34-35

vectors.name: set_gateway
vectors.description: Command 0x90: enable programming + program default gateway 2.0.0.1
vectors.source: Art-Net 4 rev 1.4dp (23/10/2025), ArtIpProg packet definition p.34-35
